title: Juniper Studio Service Proposal
lead: Replace the fragmented booking journey with one accessible flow, delivered in three reviewable stages.
label: fixed fee for the defined scope
intro: The fictional engagement covers research synthesis, interaction design and a tested frontend prototype for a neighborhood arts venue. Production integration is a separate engagement.
sections: Two stakeholder workshops, six core screens, responsive specifications, accessible component states and a documented prototype handoff.
One named decision owner consolidates feedback within three working days. Each stage ends with a review, not an implied approval.
Invoices follow the milestones below. The estimate excludes taxes, third-party subscriptions, production hosting and changes outside the agreed six screens.
closing: Offer valid for 30 days · Start date follows written acceptance.
prompt: Use Dazzler to create a fictional business document and web edition for this task: Replace the fragmented booking journey with one accessible flow, delivered in three reviewable stages. Retain every supplied fact and qualification. A proposal foldout separates fee and boundaries from the three staged deliverables; the fee is a side annotation, not the page opener. Use Poppins for the web and verified Arial for native output, with #4D2298 against #EAC7FF. Author a distinct composition rather than recoloring the previous release. Keep native text and tables editable and verify narrow layouts.
colorDirection: Acid-lime proposal with deep green delivery ledger; optimistic commercial energy.
